senses.gloss:
इद् ind.
—1 A particle of affirmation, even, just, only; यथा वशन्ति देवास्तथेदसद्
 Rv. 8. 28. 4 especially in strengthening a statement; अर्थज्ञ इत्सकलं
 भद्रमश्नुते Nir.
—2 It is often added to words expressing excess or exclusion: विश्व इत् एक इत् &c.
—3 At the beginning of sentences it often adds emphasis to pronouns, prepositions
 &c. (its place is taken by एव in classical Sanskrit).
